# Provenance

On 2026-07-19, the `deploy-staging` job restored a stale cache entry because the cache key was keyed only on branch name and did not include the lockfile hash (Source 2, 14:07). The stale artifact caused the staging deployment to serve a build from the previous week (Source 2, 14:02). Approximately forty minutes elapsed before the root cause was identified through bisection to the cache step (Source 2, 14:31 and 14:44). The fix was to add the lockfile hash to the cache key (Source 2, 14:31). This was the first observed instance of this failure mode in the incident history (Source 2, 14:44).
